decisions.reason: GA4 is Google's only supported analytics platform after Universal Analytics was retired, so shop operators still need a GA4 tracking plugin.
Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2023 and for 360 customers in 2024, so the plugin no longer has a working purpose.
Interfaces between shops and retail systems serve a lasting integration need and bring in recurring revenue for a shop-focused agency.
SEO support during shop relaunches is a core consulting service with its own page and steady demand from shop platform migrations.
